title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Final Trailer Reveals New Villain
excerpt: Sony has released the final trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day, unveiling an invisible threat and a new chapter for Peter Parker. The film, directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, launches a new trilogy. Here's a technical breakdown of the trailer and what fans can expect from the film's cutting-edge visual effects.
description: Final Spider-Man: Brand New Day trailer reveals an invisible villain. Tom Holland embarks on a new trilogy from Destin Daniel Cretton. Stunning VFX on display.
